title: SvgPolyline
responsibility: Renders the native polyline element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgPolyline.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet rendered inside the native SVG <polyline> when truthy; if omitted or falsy, no child content is rendered. The component invokes it without arguments and does not transform its output.

outputs.name: SvgPolyline
outputs.description: Renders one native SVG <polyline> with all non-children props spread onto it and no added wrapper. The optional children snippet is rendered inside the element only when truthy.
